0022600131.text: The 2-0 Trail Blazers, who are 4th in the West and 2nd in the Northwest, 1 game back, visit the 3-0 Los Angeles Lakers, who lead the Pacific and sit 3rd in the West. Portland is without Chris Youngblood (out, ankle soreness), Shaedon Sharpe (out, knee surgery), Branden Carlson (day-to-day, concussion), and Scoot Henderson (day-to-day, ankle soreness), with Carlson and Henderson both game-time decisions, while Los Angeles is missing Adou Thiero (out, knee inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Portland won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, including a 132-116 win in Portland on January 17, 2026.
